description: This Java class, ValidateMethod, is part of the org.apache.ofbiz.minilang.operation package. It defines a string operation used to invoke a validation method dynamically via reflection, based on configuration or XML element attributes. The class handles converting input values, locating the specified class and method, invoking it, and managing validation results and errors.

classes.name: ValidateMethod
classes.description: A string operation class that calls a validation method specified in XML attributes, performing validation via reflection and handling conversion, errors, and messaging.

methods.name: ValidateMethod
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validation class and method names from XML element attributes, setting defaults as needed.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Performs the validation by converting input, dynamically loading the class, invoking the specified method, and handling the validation result and errors.
